score_health.description: healthy = comfortably below 0.5; borderline = close to 0.5; too-easy = 0.5 or above.

difficulty_source.description: legitimate = real research depth and judgement; artificial = clerical transcription, ambiguity, or brittle exact-matching.

verdict.description: Overall judgement of how well this task is constructed.

why_this_score.description: What about the task's construction produced this score. Two sentences. Remember low is good — explain what is keeping it hard, or what made it drift easy.

components.description: One entry for each part reviewed.

issue.description: What is wrong, in general terms. Say 'none' if it is fine.

score_effect.description: Direction only. Easier is the risk; harder is fine if the difficulty is legitimate.

guideline_compliance.description: Whether it looks compliant with task realism, golden solution, rubric similarity and rubric fairness — and where not.

top_fix.description: The single most valuable change. One sentence. Never propose raising the score.
